name: repository-presenter-mermaid-check
description: Pinned renderer for the At a Glance diagram check (components/readme_diagram/render_check.py): the mermaid package the project targets, three more releases to prove the layout holds across them, and puppeteer-core to drive an installed Chrome or Edge. Install with: npm ci --ignore-scripts (PUPPETEER_SKIP_DOWNLOAD=1), then export RP_MERMAID_TOOLS=<this directory>.
